# Devoxel Engine

> A modular, WebGPU-powered Voxel Engine architecture designed for high-performance chunk rendering and AI-driven development.

## Core Documentation

- [AI Agent Rules](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/.github/agents/agents.md): Crucial rules for AI agents modifying this codebase.
- [Skill Definition](https://github.com/deftorch/devoxel-engine/blob/main/skill.md): Engine capabilities and technical constraints.

## Engine Structure

- `/voxel-engine/src/core`: The shared core containing WebGPU renderers, bitECS components, and math utilities.
- `/voxel-engine/src/game`: The runtime logic for the game, including chunk generation workers and UI.
- `/voxel-engine/src/data`: The data-driven JSON registries (e.g., blocks, materials).

## Entry Points

- Game Runtime: `/voxel-engine/index.html`
- Standalone Editor: `/voxel-engine/editor.html`
